shared_elements: circular/disc motif on the body or field
bilateral symmetry about a central axis
low-relief carving of the human form
repeated linear incised patterning (rows of lines/curls)
justification: Both depict human-like figures rendered in low relief with symmetrical composition and incised circular/disc elements, but these are generic traits. A shows a narrative scene of winged attendant figures flanking a stylised plant with a band of script below, while B shows a single massive head-and-torso figure with schematic facial features and abstract markings on its back, with no flanking, no plant, and no inscription.
